outcome.detail: Full gate passed: validators 8/8, 93 validator self-tests; LabSupport 97, LabDomain 156, LabStore 44, LabStaging 40, LabDemo 119, LabFeatures 363 tests in 9 runs (commerce 18). Mac 134 total: 131 passed, 1 expected failure, 2 skipped; both commerce host tests passed. iOS simulator 4, watchOS simulator 115, tvOS simulator 116 passed. Release profiles passed product policy. Verified simulated grants and restores produced app-UI receipts; unverified compass produced no entitlement or new receipt.

limitations: Fixture host calls, not an outside UI walkthrough, physical-device commerce qualification, or a StoreKit transaction. The iPhone commerce screen compiled, but its flow was not separately driven.
The local StoreKit configuration service probe is blocked separately; no StoreKit-backed purchase adapter exists.
Existing known issues remain: Share Ingress duplicate recognition and same-second arrival ordering; Mac expected failure and skipped tests remain unqualified.
Physical devices, iPad, manual VoiceOver / Voice Control / Full Keyboard Access, and a 26-SDK / Swift 6.2 build were not run.
The script created and cleaned up its own iOS 27.0, watchOS 27.0, and tvOS 27.0 simulators; this is simulator evidence, never physical-device proof.
